title: Projective charts from bounded finite lisse residue on an affine weakly contractible scheme
statement: Fix l and E and the canonical completed integral coefficients [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Let f:V→W with V affine and terminal-object evaluation on sheaves of sets carrying epimorphisms to surjections [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let M,N be derived module sheaves on W [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Suppose the ordinary uncompleted derived pullback of each to V is complete [def-weil-derived-complete, def-sf-ordinary-integral-derived-pullback] and its exponent-one residue reduction has a finite ordered cohomology interval and locally constant finite module models in all degrees [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction, def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf]. There is one finite disjoint open cover of V with qcqs members, on every member of which both composite ordinary pullbacks to W have bounded cochain representatives whose terms are split retracts of finite products of the completed integral unit sheaf. This is independent of any chosen residue trivializations or chosen projective-model covers.

proof.text: The exponent-one quotient is a field, by the maximal-ideal identification proved in the residue Tor-bound module. Apply the already proved bounded_field_tor lemma in FieldTorAmplitude to the given bounded residue complex. It supplies the all-representatives, all-K-flat-resolutions Tor interval directly. This is residueFiniteTor in the Lean proof.

Convert finite local residue models to fixed finite locally constant sheaves. The trivial stratification gives intrinsic constructibility; the support is a subset of the finite integer interval. This is residueConstructible in the Lean proof.

Convert the epimorphism evaluation property to categorical weak contractibility. Apply the existing residue-lisse projective-model theorem separately to M and N, then apply the common clopen refinement lemma to their two completed model covers.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_common_projective_charts
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (W V : Scheme.{u}) (f : V ⟶ W) [IsAffine V]
    (hweak : ∀ (F G : Sheaf (ProEt.topology V) (Type (u + 1)))
      (g : F ⟶ G), Epi g →
        Function.Surjective (g.hom.app (Opposite.op (ProEt.mk (𝟙 V)))))
    (M N : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E W))
    (hresidue :
(∀ K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E W),
          K = M ∨ K = N →
          IntegralOnSlice.IsComplete l E V none
            ((ordinaryIntegralDerivedPull l E f).obj K) ∧
          ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧
            (∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q → IsZero
              ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
                ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E V 0).obj
                  ((ordinaryIntegralDerivedPull l E f).obj K)))) ∧
            (∀ q : ℤ, IsLocallyConstantProEtaleModuleSheafWithModelsOfUniverses V
              (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E 1)
              (fun L ↦ Module.Finite (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E 1)) L)
              ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
                ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E V 0).obj
                  ((ordinaryIntegralDerivedPull l E f).obj K)))))) :
          ∃ (c : ℕ) (U : Fin c → V.Opens),
            (⨆ i, U i) = ⊤ ∧ Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (U i) (U j)) ∧
            (∀ i, CompactSpace (U i).toScheme) ∧
            (∀ i, QuasiSeparatedSpace (U i).toScheme) ∧
            ∀ (i : Fin c) (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E W)),
              K = M ∨ K = N →
              ∃ (P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E (U i).toScheme) ℤ)
                (a b : ℤ), a ≤ b ∧ P.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ P.IsStrictlyLE b ∧
                (∀ q : ℤ, ∃ (r : ℕ)
                  (ι : P.X q ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun _ : Fin r ↦ SheafOfModules.unit
                    (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E (U i).toScheme))
                  (ρ : (∏ᶜ fun _ : Fin r ↦ SheafOfModules.unit
                    (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E (U i).toScheme))
                    ⟶ P.X q), ι ≫ ρ = 𝟙 _) ∧
                Nonempty ((ordinaryIntegralDerivedPull l E
                  ((U i).ι ≫ f)).obj K ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)
